vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 30s, with a buzz cut, Evelyn, Willow and the woman in her 60s met them at the door — 4 put down. the person in their 30s, with a buzz cut, Evelyn, Willow are hurt.
🛡️ Natalie, Evelyn, Willow and Ray met them at the door — 4 put down. Willow, Ray are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Natalie, Evelyn, Willow and Ray met them at the door — 4 put down. Natalie, Evelyn, Willow, Ray are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

killerTaleLog: [day 7] the woman in her 30s: The fire settles. the woman in her 30s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Something huge, rooting in the underbrush — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the person in their 30s, with a buzz cut mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" the woman in her 60s says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 8] Natalie: The fire settles. Natalie has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ava says quietly "And you're still standing." Zoe breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 8] Evelyn: The fire settles. Evelyn has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Zoe asks "We've been walking past those." Ava asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 8] Iga: The fire settles. Iga has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Natalie asks "Say that again — slower." Naran breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 10] Naran: The fire settles. Naran has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Inspiration — I put it down today." "It brightens. The light is too white, too certain. EUREKA — the biggest burst so far." "It flickers — a smaller, meaner idea. Less certain, faster." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ava asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Boris says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 12] Boris: The fire settles. Boris has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Moderator — I put it down today." "It reviews you. 'Content noted.' A weak ranging chip while it decides." "'REMOVAL NOTICE.' Defiant or compliant — the hammer is coming down." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ava asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Naran asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 15] Willow: The fire settles. Willow has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Rut King — I put it down today." "He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath." "His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Zoe says quietly "And you're still standing." Ava says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 18] Boris: The fire settles. Boris has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ava says "Did it look at you? Before?" Pavel says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 18] Ray: The fire settles. Ray has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Understudy — I put it down today." "It watches your weapon. It lifts its own — a perfect, insulting copy at half fidelity." "It starts performing — and your most-used move is suddenly anticipated, halved, ANSWERED." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Zoe says "We've been walking past those." Iga says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 19] Zoe: The fire settles. Zoe has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Willow breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Pavel asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 23] Ava: The fire settles. Ava has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Tick — I put it down today." "It waits. The questing legs wave — the tell." "Adjacent = attached. No dodge. It's ON you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Zoe says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Natalie says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 24] Natalie: The fire settles. Natalie has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Lockpick — I put it down today." "It sits up. Its hands move too fast to follow. Something you own is suddenly in its hands." "Cornered, it shows its teeth. It fights second — but it fights." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Boris says "The fire feels smaller now." Iga breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 25] Natalie: The fire settles. Natalie has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Leo says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Willow breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 25] Ray: The fire settles. Ray has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Naran asks "So it bleeds." Evelyn asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 26] Naran: The fire settles. Naran has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Chorus Line — I put it down today." "The music starts — an actual audio cue, 4/4, and you can feel the downbeat coming. The downbeat is the kick. Deafness breaks the telegraph but not the beat." "The count stutters — ONE-two-THREE-and— the kick comes on the off-beat, where your dancing feet aren’t." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Pavel says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Iga mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 31] Leo: The fire settles. Leo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ad Break — I put it down today." "A giant floating AD glyph with a PROGRESS BAR — the bar is the telegraph. During the pause it repositions and heals, and you watch. After the bar fills, a 'skip ad' beat appears: skip faster if the audience likes you. Or look away — the ad's power is that you WATCH." "A glowing can rotates beside it — ‘THIS REGENERATION BROUGHT TO YOU BY—’ It drinks. It heals." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Pavel says "So it bleeds." Ava breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
